fields.title: Authentication vs Authorization
fields.inputs/3/label: User opens someone else's order via link
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: For each situation: what is the problem and what to show.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/3: User opens someone else's order via link
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — authentication, `401`, login preserving the cart. 2 — authorization, `403`, explanation "network manager rights required", do not offer login. 3 — authentication, message without specifying what exactly is wrong. 4 — authorization, `404` instead of `403`: no need to disclose that someone else's order exists. The latter is subtle: sometimes the correct answer is "not found" instead of "forbidden".
